why_not_the_test_bundle: xcodebuild refuses tool-hosted testing on a device destination, so the package test bundles cannot run on a phone at all — the same wall App/BodySkinSelfTest.swift documents. The self-test drives the product objects: LivePreviewController.open, beginManualMaskStroke/extendManualMaskStroke/endManualMaskStroke, then LivePreviewRenderer.render(_:).

brush.source: ManualMaskBrushSettings() — the brush bar's shipping defaults

paint.note: beginStroke + 119 extendStroke calls on the main actor, exactly as CanvasView's drag handler issues them. The session does not wait on the GPU, by design.

render.control: the same graph, same photo, same run, with gateMasks empty

second_run.note: A second launch of the same build reproduces the paint and undo figures exactly (0.084 ms/point, 30.1 ms) and puts the gate's marginal cost at -0.03 ms — i.e. below this measurement's noise, which is the honest reading of both runs: one extra r8 dispatch is not visible next to a 6 ms skin composite.

undo.note: One undo of a 120-point stroke at this preview size. The macOS run measures the deep case (19 strokes replayed, 426.9 ms) — see p6-manual-mask-macos.json; a replay is linear in stamps, so history depth is what costs, not the undo itself.

verdict: Closes ADR-0019's stated blocker ('a ms/frame on an A-series part is required before it is turned on'). Gated redraw 6.33 ms = 158 fps at the preview size, 0.09 ms of which is the gate; 0.084 ms of main thread per touch event. RPEngineFeatureFlags.manualMask was turned on in AppEngineSetup on the strength of these numbers.
